record: North Carolina SHPO, approved National Register nomination GS0001 (NRIS 73001343), description section
facts: The south tower is taller and carries a Roman-numeral clock above three lower stages. Both towers use octagonal spires and brick belfries with pointed arches. A four-bay nave precedes the crossing and two choir bays follow. The west narthex is from 1965, the east sacristy is one storey, and each transept gable has an oculus.
Official title and date of construction, 1892; renovation, 1965.
